verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH client backed by a vendor-run, end-to-end encrypted cloud vault and sync service, so self-hosting that backend is a fair question. The evidence shows no self-hosted server or on-prem deployment option. The local-storage and offline-connection claim describes local-first client behavior, an adjacent feature rather than self-hosting, and community comments describe the product as closed-source with keys stored on Termius' servers.
